sources.beginner: hand-calc: composite (Standing/Vogel) IPR closed forms taught in beginner m03-m05 and the working-the-capstone lesson; pd-ipr-explorer panel is teaching wells only
sources.intermediate: tubing curve constants (nodalLab.js CAP gGrav/qRef/kFric) are NOT stated anywhere a learner can see, so fields 1-4 are unobtainable; the gas column needs the engine (Cullender and Smith) but pd-vlp-explorer only runs teaching wells
sources.advanced: node crossings and sweep depend on the same unstated tubing constants; pd-node-explorer runs teaching wells only (NodeExplorer.jsx:661)

fix.redesign: State the three tubing constants in the Professional and Expert prompts ('bhp(q) = pWh + 3835 / (1 + q/600) + 0.000238 q^2, psia'), and in the Professional prompt state that the 49 points run evenly from one thousandth of the open flow to the open flow. The form is already taught (intermediate/m03-what-moves-the-curve/l03-water-cut-and-density.md:9), and with the constants stated every value is spreadsheet-reproducible: verified here, the sampled minimum and both ends match exactly and bisection roots on the 900-point scan land within 1.3e-6 stb/d of expected.

fields.recommendation: Amend the two prompts to state the constants (no graded value moves). Without that the six Expert fields and four Professional fields cannot be obtained by any route the course offers.
fields.evidence: The prompt says 'the gravity-plus-friction relation supplied with this capstone' but never states its constants (gGrav 3835 psi, qRef 600 stb/d, kFric 0.000238 psi/(stb/d)^2 live only in /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/nodal/nodalLab.js:99-120 (CAP)). They are not in any lesson, panel or the capstone card (NodalLearningPage.jsx:317-318 renders only title and prompt; the dataset column is not shown), and panelCapstoneGuard.test.js forbids panels from reading CAP. Given the constants it is a spreadsheet job (49 samples from AOF x 1e-3 to AOF, pick the smallest bhp): reproduces 1285.2338376891 exactly.

fields.recommendation: Add editable column inputs to the panel (six-decimal print clears the 7.6e-4 tol). Alternative: name and point to a Suite route, but no lesson references one.
fields.evidence: All column inputs are stated (sg 0.72, 1225 psia, 8900 MD, 8300 TVD, 96 to 214 degF, 20 steps) and the vendored engine returns 1516.5314295864 exactly, but the only column the learner can run is the teaching wells' (the GasColumn view has a well selector and no inputs). A hand march needs the engine's z-factor correlation, per-interval fixed-point iteration closed to 0.001 psi and a Simpson refinement (intermediate/m04-the-gas-column/l02-cullender-and-smith.md:27); that closure tolerance is itself comparable to the 7.6e-4 psi grading tol.
